concept: Appreciating people while they're present, not just after they're gone or unavailable
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student reflects on a relationship they may be taking for granted in the busyness of daily life
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides on one concrete way to express appreciation now, rather than waiting
exercise.practice: Student drafts or plans an actual message or action of appreciation

assessment.success_marker: student names a real, specific person and a genuine planned action, not a vague intention
